announced.text: Started manual print on the H2D for the baseplate. Estimated print time is roughly 2.5hrs.

job.source_of_these_fields: Bambu Studio 02.08.02.61, home page -> Print History -> Base (the lab account's cloud task list), runner clock in UTC
job.kind: Gcode: a sliced file sent from Studio; not cloud-sliced and not a public MakerWorld profile
job.public_link_note: Bambu gives a cloud print task no shareable URL; it is visible only when logged in to the lab account (Studio Print History or Bambu Handy)

device_page_first_read.progress: 80 %, layer 109 -> 112 of 261, 30 -> 29 min left, estimated finish 22:16 UTC
device_page_first_read.ams: left AMS (16 % humidity): A2 black PLA (feeding the left nozzle), A4 blue PLA, A1 and A3 empty; right AMS (6 %): empty; external spool: TPU (feeding the right nozzle)
device_page_first_read.hms: one maintenance reminder, no faults: 'Please clean and lubricate the X-axis linear rail, YZ-axis linear rods, and the extruder lift linear rail.'

installed: hardened steel 0.6 mm, TPU High flow
nozzles.sides: not labelled in the dialog; the job prints from the left nozzle and the right one is fed TPU, so the 0.4 mm Standard nozzle is most likely the left one
nozzles.earlier_today: 04:32-05:41 UTC: both 0.6 mm (Standard and TPU High flow), docs/prints/2026-11-04-baseplate-h2d/

source.match: the job's thumbnail shows the same part as Onshape's render (cad/onshape-193/baseplate/base/iso.png)

file.why: the sent 3MF is in the printer's cache, which Studio's Storage tab does not list (its Model list holds only five files from 2026-08); reading /cache needs LAN FTPS, which a print run doesn't have; Studio's cloud token is encrypted on disk, so the task's file wasn't fetched through Bambu's API either

watch.method: Device page screenshots every 30 s, OCR of the job panel; never clicked

final.finished_utc: 2026-11-04T22:18Z (job panel: 100 %, layer 261/261, Finished; the Printing label went between 22:18:04 and 22:18:36; bed target 0 by 22:18:04, left nozzle target 0 by 22:18:36)
final.elapsed_from_start: about 2 h 40 min from 19:38 (Studio estimate 2 h 32 min 27 s, which leaves out heating and calibration)
final.read: the part looks complete on the textured PEI plate, toolhead parked top left; what looks like a slim support stands under each hinge block; nothing loose or stringy that I can see
final.hms: no dialog appeared during the watch; the HMS list was not re-read after the finish
final.thread: polled every 30 s from 21:55 to 22:18 UTC; no new comments
